caution_findings.finding: DBAASP sequence rows for the seven ADEP analogs use X-containing placeholder strings (XSPXAP or XXPXAP) for noncanonical cyclic depsipeptide structures. Source Table 1/SI chemistry supports the compounds and MIC rows, but exact chemical structures are not normalized into linear peptide sequences.

DBAASPS_24248 is named ADEP IDR-10001 in DBAASP while the current primary paper labels the matched current-study compound as 1a; value triplet, citation links, and merged sequence/literature rows support the mapping, so this is retained as a caution rather than an open conflict.

The packet supplementary_index reports zero supplementary assets, but source XML and the OA package contain the SI PDF and two CIF files. The SI PDF text and package inventory were reviewed; CIF files do not change MIC/database adjudication.

Direct mechanism is restricted to ClpP activation/ClpX competition and conformational biophysics. The authors' permeability explanation remains a hypothesis because no direct permeability assay was recovered locally.
